responsibility: Implements the initializer AST node classes and basic initializer-side utilities. It provides syntax copying, textual rendering, aggregate element accumulation for struct and array initializers, conversion of array initializers to associative-array literals when possible, and helper checks for whether constant initializer expressions contain non-const pointers, supporting later initializer semantic analysis and constant-data decisions.
same_name_distinction: This `.c` file is the implementation side of `init`; unlike `init.h`, which declares the initializer node classes and interfaces, it defines their behavior such as syntax copying, text rendering, aggregate-element accumulation, associative-array-literal conversion, and helper analysis of pointer-containing initializer expressions.
